methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Based on the results, it can be said that the energy consumption of food-packaging and bottling machines is described by a limited discrete number of energy states related to the operational state.

paper_type.evidence_quote: To obtain representative data, five bottling plants using typical packaging types (returnable glass and PET bottles) and products (water, soft drinks, and beer) were considered for the data analysis.

level_3b.evidence_quote: electrical energy consumption data and operational state data of 20 machines in industrial applications were considered to characterize the consumption behavior of bottling and packaging machines in the food and beverage industry.

stage1.notes: Beverage bottling and packaging is outside the closed Level 3B sector list.

multi_site.evidence_quote: All machines of two bottling plants were analyzed, and for the other ones, only the main consumers (bottle cleaning machine or stretch-blow moulder) were taken into account.

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: Beverages and liquid foods are packaged in industrial bottling plants consisting of an arbitrary number of cooperating machines and aggregates (manufacturing stations)

evidence_quote: customary specifications refer to the energy consumption for a specific number of products (e.g., kWh/1000 fillings)
the energy consumption of food-packaging and bottling machines is described by a limited discrete number of energy states related to the operational state
